symptom: `actionbutton b (Action: call microflow System.ShowHomePage)` passed check but exec refused it: 'failed to resolve microflow: microflow not found: System.ShowHomePage'. describe prints exactly this for Studio Pro's 'Show home page' on-click, so the description did not round-trip.
cause: #2247 taught check and navigation the System module's built-in microflows (meta.SystemMicroflows), which are not stored in the .mpr; the page builder's microflow lookup lists only project units and was not told.
fix: resolveMicroflow returns an empty ID with no error for a name in meta.SystemMicroflows; the action is stored by name.
insight: A list of things that exist outside the project (meta.SystemMicroflows) has to be consulted by every resolver, not only the one whose bug introduced it: grep the list's users when adding one, and check exec's resolver as well as check's. Verified on 11.14.0: a snippet and a page button with the action exec, describe back unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
